wren.title: Punt
wren.style: Mixed Martial Arts · Look See Do

L1.note: Fast check. Chains into Cross, cancels into specials.

L2.note: Second hit of the string. Cancels into the third hit or a special.

L3.note: String ender. Pushes back; punishable up close on block.

JL.note: Punch on the way down. Jump in, then combo on landing.

JH.note: Flying kick to the body. Strong jump-in; blockable.

H.note: Long kick. Special-cancel on hit; knocks down on counter.

FH.note: Advancing spin with big pushback; safe at tip range.

S.note: Signature. Slow, airborne, devastating; very punishable if blocked.

FS.note: Travelling jump kick. Ends light strings; knocks down.

BS.note: Full gauge: more strike damage, half damage from flame for 8 s.

T.note: Beats blocking. Toward: double-leg slam. Away: shoulder throw, swaps sides.

DF.note: Rolls through strikes and past the opponent.

L1.note: Fast jab. Chains into the elbow, cancels into specials.

L2.note: Stepping horizontal elbow. Cancels into the knee or a special.

JL.note: Elbow on the way down. Jump in, then combo on landing.

JH.note: Jumping knee to the body. Strong jump-in; blockable.

H.note: Muay Thai body kick. Special-cancel on hit.

FH.note: Teep. Long reach, huge pushback; controls space.

S.note: Leaping downward elbow wreathed in crimson flame. Knocks down.

FS.note: Flying knee with flame. Ends light strings; knocks down.

BS.note: Half gauge: invulnerable flame burst. Heavily punishable if blocked.

T.note: Beats blocking. Toward: clinch knees. Away: clinch turn, swaps sides.

DF.note: Rolls through strikes and past the opponent.

DB.note: Quick retreating roll. Recovery is punishable.
